bodyHtml:
[§587A-36]  Appeal.  An interested party aggrieved by any order or decree of the court under this chapter may appeal as provided in section 571-54. [L 2010, c 135, pt of §1]

 

Rules of Court

 

  See Rules Expediting Child Protective Appeals.
